usedFor: A new Zoho CRM account starts App Store and Google Play tracking in Applyra.

bestTemplate.name: “New Account” in Zoho CRM, then “Track App” in Applyra
bestTemplate.why: A new account is the natural moment to begin rank tracking for a customer's app.

watchOut: “Track App” needs a store ID, country and language, which a CRM record may not carry.
